placementAdvice.text: Slots are up to 48 px wide with 8 px gaps, plus 8 px padding, so 6 digits need 344 px at full size.

placementAdvice.text: In a wider container, slots stay 48 px at the left.

placementAdvice.text: Figma and the package agree on 48 px slots and 8 px gaps, and on a right-aligned support line with a small Resend button.

examples.purpose: Verifying a phone number, the guide's In context: a Card with a heading line, a line saying where the code went, and a 6-digit OTP with a 30-second resend timer. The screen keeps the code (value and onChange), checks it when the last digit is entered (onComplete), and sets isInvalid; errorMessage then replaces the timer.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <Text text="Verify your number" />
    <Text text="We sent a 6-digit code to your phone." />
    <OTP
      value=""
      onChange={() => {}}
      onComplete={() => {}}
      isInvalid={false}
      errorMessage="Incorrect code. Try again."
      resend={{ durationSeconds: 30, onResend: () => {} }}
    />
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: The screen keeps the code, checks it when the last digit is entered, and sets the error.

props.name: length
props.description: Slots shrink to fit the container with a 48 px cap: 8 digits in a 334 px parent get 32.8 px slots and fit, 7 digits in 360 px get 42.3 px, 6 digits in 334 px get 46.3 px, and a wide parent keeps 48 px. Declared: Number of OTP digits. Defaults to 6. Default 6, from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value of the OTP input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default value for uncontrolled usage. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the OTP value changes. Receives the current string of entered digits.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Alias for onChange — called when the OTP value changes.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when all digits have been entered. Receives the complete OTP string.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the OTP input is disabled. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the OTP input is in an invalid/error state. Drives underline colour and (optionally) the error message. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: allowedPattern
props.description: Regex pattern to filter allowed characters. Defaults to digits only.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Auto-focus the input on mount. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes for Figma token resolution.

props.name: supportText
props.description: Long support or error text wraps inside the field; short text stays on one line, right-aligned. Declared: Optional SupportText rendered below the slots. Pass a string for the label or a ReactNode for full control.

props.name: supportTextStatus
props.description: SupportText status when using the string shorthand.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Convenience: shown beneath the slots **only** while `isInvalid` is true. Renders with status="Error" automatically. When omitted, the regular `supportText` is shown instead (with status promoted to Error).

props.name: resend
props.description: The “Resend OTP in Ns” countdown sits at the right of the support row; when it ends, Resend is a 32 px tall Button at the right. Declared: When provided, replaces the support area with a managed countdown that decays into a "Resend" button. Hidden while `isInvalid` is true so the error message can take precedence.

props.name: enableSmsAutofill
props.description: Enable native one-time-code auto-fill on the underlying TextInput. On iOS this surfaces the SMS code in the QuickType bar above the keyboard (system-managed; no library required). On Android this sets `autoComplete="one-time-code"`, which the OS can auto-fill from notifications when the host app is wired up to the SMS Retriever or SMS User Consent APIs. Defaults to true. Default true, from the component source.
